PM Modi Highlights Digital India's Global Impact and Governance Improvements

Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that the Digital India initiative has provided the country with a new global identity. He also noted that digital governance has enhanced administrative effectiveness and transparency. The initiative's impact spans sectors from education and health to agriculture.
